Consultation: annual accountant's reports for firms holding client money

Published 2 October 2026

The Northbridge Legal Standards Authority (NLSA) is consulting on changes to the Accounts Rules.

We propose that every law firm that holds client money must send us an accountant's report every year. At present, firms only send a report when their accountant qualifies it.

We also propose a fixed penalty for reports that are late or missing.

We have not yet decided when the change would start. That will depend on the responses we receive.

The consultation is open until 27 November 2026. Any firm we regulate that holds client money is affected. Firms that never hold client money are not affected.

Northbridge Legal Standards Authority. Test page, not a real regulator.
